notes: The italic the blessing is marked added under rule 17; the alternative would fold it into the verb's frame.
The Sh on תָּבוֹאתָה is paragogic, not directive, so it is unrepresented under rule 32.
good will heads on will, which the ASV elsewhere writes alone for רָצוֹן, so it is not a supplied generic (rule 31's tie sentence); crown of the head heads on crown.
